title: Request Data Access
description: Request access to catalog, schema, and table resources

elements.name: sla_info
elements.html:
SLA:

Data access requests are typically processed within 3-5 business days. Requests involving sensitive data (PII, financial, etc.) require data owner approval and may take up to 7-10 business days. High-volume query requests (>1000 queries/day) need additional infrastructure review.

elements.name: important_notes
elements.html:
Important Notes:
  • Use the exact catalog and schema names as they appear in Unity Catalog - case-sensitive!
  • If you need access to multiple schemas, list them all in one request (comma-separated) to speed up processing
  • Leave table names blank if you need access to all tables in a schema - you can request specific tables later
  • Be specific about your query volume - this helps us provision the right resources
  • Data owner approval is required for production data - include the data owner's email in your justification if known
  • Access is granted at the catalog level by default - schema and table access are additional permissions
